summary: Iter 85 — Staff Tasks API + Mobile Premium UX Polish. Backend 11/11 tests pass (Tasks CRUD + 5 staff-endpoint smoke regression). Frontend mobile staff portal flows verified end-to-end: BottomNav nav-buttons all present (home/shifts/tasks/wallet/profile), tab transitions work for tasks/wallet/profile/home, Tasks tab loads 3 demo cards + filter buttons + optimistic complete (3→2 cards after click), Wallet tab balance/bonus/tips/open-full all rendered, Profile hero/lang/pin/logout all present, Language sheet opens with staff-lang-de visible. KPI grid (kpi-today/week/overtime/wallet) and staff-live-status-card render correctly on Home. Merchant Overview testids verified in source (merchant-live-status, merchant-quick-actions, merchant-activity-feed, merchant-kpi-active/break/leave/month).

minor.issue: TaskCreate.title has no min_length/strip; empty-string title is accepted (would create task with empty title). Add Pydantic validator.
Idempotency not enforced — re-completing an already-done task still returns 200 and overwrites completed_at. Consider returning current state if status already done.

ui_bugs.issue: When shifts list is empty, component returns <EmptyState/> directly WITHOUT wrapping in `data-testid=staff-shifts-tab`. Test for tab transition staff-nav-shifts → staff-shifts-tab fails when no shifts exist. staff-empty-state IS rendered but the tab container testid is missing.

Click on staff-attachment-checkin-btn did not surface staff-attachment-sheet within 900ms. The button is in StaffHome (child) but the sheet is rendered in StaffMobilePage (parent). State-bridging via prop callback may not be wired correctly for mobile viewport, OR the sheet expects an active clock-in session before opening.

integration_issues.issue: Works correctly: clicking staff-task-complete-{id} removes the card from open list within ~1s (3→2). Backend update confirmed via test.

issues: Embedded Emergent chat-widget (bottom-right) overlaps the rightmost BottomNav tab (Profile) at viewport 414×896 and can intercept clicks/auto-expand fullscreen on stray tap. In test had to inject CSS to hide. Recommend giving the BottomNav a higher z-index or hiding chat widget on /staff/mobile route.

Frontend StaffProfile.jsx PinChangeSheet uses BottomSheet with backdrop click-to-close — no Escape-key binding. Minor UX: add Escape handler for keyboard accessibility.

StaffMobilePage.jsx is >380 lines and contains login/PIN/main shell + attachment sheet rendering — consider splitting attachment-sheet into its own component for clarity and to avoid prop-drilling that may be causing the attachment-sheet bug.
StaffBottomNav: all 5 nav testids correctly rendered (staff-nav-{id}); the active-state styling and safe-area handling look good. Badge wiring (staff-nav-task-badge) is in place.

MerchantLiveOverview.jsx: testids merchant-live-status / merchant-quick-actions / merchant-activity-feed / merchant-kpi-active/break/leave/month all present in source — not directly clicked in this run due to time, but source code matches review_request spec.

rca of the issue: 1) staff-shifts-tab missing → root cause: StaffShifts.jsx line 62-69 returns EmptyState directly when shifts.length===0; the outer div with data-testid=staff-shifts-tab is on line 75 (only rendered when shifts exist). Fix: wrap EmptyState in <div data-testid=staff-shifts-tab>. 2) staff-attachment-sheet not opening → likely state-bridging issue (StaffHome triggers callback that should toggle parent state in StaffMobilePage, but sheet did not appear within 900ms). Reproduce: login as staff → click staff-attachment-checkin-btn on Home → expect staff-attachment-sheet to appear. Investigate prop callback path or check if sheet is gated on clock state.
